@anecdotal @andy_matuschak @_TamaraWinter So true. At most, they establish a baseline knowledge or set a bar for what “good” looks like. @andy_matuschak @anecdotal @_TamaraWinter So very helpful. Thank you, Andy. I’ll keep you posted on how we go! Regardless of its success, I do love the Oppenheimer model of making the engagement more playful — removes the anxiety for those who are trying to grok concepts that don’t come intuitively.
